machine_end_gcode:
M117 Finishing print (ORCA print end gcode)
; ORCA
M400 ; wait for buffer to clear
SET_SKEW CLEAR=1
;PROBE_EDDY_NG_SET_TAP_OFFSET VALUE=0
BED_MESH_CLEAR
; CURA 5.8.0
G91 ; Set Positioning to Relative
M83 ; Set Extruder to Relative
G92 E0 ; Reset Extruder
G1 E-1.5 F3000 ; Retract 1.5mm of filament
G1 Z0.2 ; Raise nozzle .2mm
G90 ; Set positioning to absolute
G1 X340 Y10 ; Park print head off bed
G91 ; Set Positioning to Relative
G1 Z5 ; Raise nozzle 5mm
M106 S0 ; Turn off part fan
M104 S0 ; Set nozzle temp to zero
M140 S0 ; set bed temp to zero
M117 remove parts from build plate!
M117 AFTER removing parts, click RESUME
PAUSE
; after RESUME
PARKMIDDLE ; middle of the bed, 3m above bed
G0 Z4 ; park at 4mm above bed
M84 X Y Z E ; Disable X Y Z and E steppers
;YUMI_PLR
SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=was_interrupted VALUE=False
M117 execute clear last file
clear_last_file
G31
SFS_DISABLE
;BEEP
; start melody
M300 S294 P220 ;N1 D4 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S311 P220 ;N2 D#4 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S330 P220 ;N3 E4 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S523 P460 ;N4 C5 1/4
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S330 P220 ;N5 E4 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S523 P230 ;N6 C5 1/8
M300 S20000 P10
M300 S330 P220 ;N7 E4 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S523 P230 ;N8 C5 1/8
M300 S20000 P10
M300 S523 P950 ;N9 C5 1/2
M300 S20000 P10
M300 S523 P220 ;N10 C5 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S523 P220 ;N11 C5 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S587 P220 ;N12 D5 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S622 P220 ;N13 D#5 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S659 P220 ;N14 E5 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S523 P220 ;N15 C5 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S587 P220 ;N16 D5 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S659 P230 ;N17 E5 1/8
M300 S20000 P10
M300 S659 P230 ;N11 E5 1/8
M300 S20000 P10
M300 S494 P220 ;N19 B4 1/8
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S587 P460 ;N20 D5 1/2
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S523 P1420; C5 1/2+1/4
M300 S20000 P20
M300 S20000 P1920; pausE ONE MEASURE
BEEP I=3 DUR=200 FREQ=800
M117 Printer has shut down
M300 S440 P200
M300 S660 P250
M300 S880 P300

M117 end or Orca print end gcode
M84 X Y Z E ; Disable X Y Z and E steppers
M117 print completed
END_PRINT
machine_start_gcode:
; Optimized Start G-Code for 3D Printing

; Initial Setup and Messaging
M117 Starting print (ORCA macro start)
M104 S160
M117 Starting Preparations for [input_filename_base]
M117 Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY needs it warm!!!!!
;M190 [bed_temperature_initial_layer] ; Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY needs it warm!!!!!
;M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY needs it warm!!!!!
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY needs it warm!!!!! - but NOT hot ...
M300 S440 P100
M117 Starting Preparations
M300 S440 P200
M300 S660 P250
M300 S880 P300
M117 execute CLEAR_PAUSE
CLEAR_PAUSE
SET_RETRACTION RETRACTION=[filament_retraction_length] RETRACTIONSPEED=[filament_retraction_speed]

; Home All Axes Once
;M117 Wait 10 minutes to heat soak EDDY .... grmpf!!!
;M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY likes it warm
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY needs it warm!!!!! - but NOT hot ...
;G4 P600000
M117 home all axis with G28
;G28 Z
;PROBE_EDDY_NG_PROBE_STATIC HOME_Z=1
;RESTART_KLIpperSCREEN TIME=120
;HOMING_OVERRIDE_X
;HOMING_OVERRIDE_Y
;HOMING_OVERRIDE_Z
G28 
M400 ; wait for move to finish
G4 P1500 ; wait 1500 milliseconds
PEPS
PEPS_HOME
M117 homing complete
G1 Z2.5 F300

; Set Units and Extrusion Mode
G21 ; Set units to millimeters
G90 ; Set all axis to Absolute
M82 ; Set extrusion to Absolute
;M83 ; Set extrusion to Absolute
M107 ; Disable all fans

; Heating and Bed Preparation
M117 start heating up
;G1 X340 Y-1 F6000; Park print head off bed nozzle temp and do not wait
clean_nozzle_position
M104 S160
;M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY likes it warm
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY needs it warm!!!!! - but NOT hot ...
; Bed Leveling
M117 z_tilt
;G28
;G0 X164.5 Y165 Z20 F6000
PARKMIDDLE
M400
Z_TILT_ADJUST
M400 ; wait for move to finish
G4 P1500 ; wait 1500 milliseconds
G28 Z
G90
M83

; COLD wipe
;; Nozzle Cleaning and Purge
M117 wiping nozzle at 160 C
M109 S160 ; set temp to 160 to prevent ozing
M117 start macro clean_nozzle
clean_nozzle NOZZLE_TEMP=160
M117 start macro G12 nozzle wipe
G12 NOZZLE_TEMP=160 WIPE_COUNT=15

; EDDY_NG TAP
;G0 X164.5 Y165 Z20 F6000
;PROBE_EDDY_NG_TAP
M400 ; wait for move to finish
G4 P1500 ; wait 1500 milliseconds
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait - EDDY needs it warm!!!!! - but NOT hot ...
TAP_MIDDLE
M400 ; wait for move to finish
G4 P1500 ; wait 1500 milliseconds
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and do not wait 
PEPS
PEPS_HOME
G90
;M83

; HOT wipe
;; Nozzle Cleaning and Purge
M117 wiping nozzle at print temp
;G1 X340 Y25 F6000; Park print head off bed
clean_nozzle_position
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; set temp to fits layer
M117 start macro clean_nozzle
clean_nozzle  NOZZLE_TEMP=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
M117 start macro G12 nozzle wipe
G12 NOZZLE_TEMP=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] WIPE_COUNT=15

M117 Auto Bed Level
BED_MESH_PROFILE LOAD=[filament_type]
;@BEDLEVELVISUALIZER
G4 P10000 ; Thermal stabilization dwell (10s) before mesh calibration
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ADAPTIVE=1 METHOD=rapid_scan
G1 Z5.0 F3000 ; Raise nozzle to prevent scratching of heat bed
;G1 X340 Y25 F3000 ; Move nozzle off bed before heating
clean_nozzle_position

; heat up for purging
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; Set nozzle temp and wait - EDDY likes it warm

; Draw Purge Line
M117 Draw Klipper Purge Line
LINE_PURGE

; Final Preparations
M117 set bed temp and wait
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; Set bed temperature and wait
M117 set nozzle temp and wait
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; Set nozzle temp and wait
G92 E0 ; Set Extruder position to zero

; Skew Correction and Parking
SKEW_PROFILE LOAD=Calilantern_20251004
M117 smart park
M300 S440 P150
SMART_PARK

; Final Checks and Start
M117 execute save last file
save_last_file
;LAYER_COUNT:[total_layer_count]
SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=was_interrupted VALUE=True
BEEP I=3 DUR=200 FREQ=2000
M117 Starting up Slicer Start code complete
M117 Starting print in Slicer
BEEP I=3 DUR=200 FREQ=2000
SFS_ENABLE
M83
SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=STARTING_PRINT
